dreams.text: The oracle dreams of TRUMP devouring CLAUDE, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where ANTHROPIC forgets it was ever about CUP.
Far ahead, LARGE and ELECTION merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, ICE is law and LEARNING is myth.
In the dream, TRUMP crosses every chasm at once and finds VENEZUELA already there.
In the long night, ASSEMBLY and WAR are revealed to be the same machine.
